items.title: Claude outage hits multiple models again
items.summary:

items.title: Phonak’s new EON hearing aids run two AI systems on a chip built to sip power
items.summary:

items.title: The Real Future of AI and Work
items.summary: A weekend Long Reads episode built around Every's new Thesis Statements project — 100 builders and thinkers writing short essays on the future of work after automation. NLW reads through the first batch and argues the tired 'will AI take our jobs' debate is finally giving way to the questions that actually matter: how work, teams, companies, and human advantage get rebuilt.

items.title: UK fintech funding has fallen to its lowest level in at least a decade
items.summary:
Funding for UK fintech companies has dropped to its lowest level in at least ten years, according to Bloomberg, which reported the figures on Sunday. The decline lands on a sector that Britain has spent the better part of fifteen years describing as its clearest technology success story, and it fits a pattern visible across the […]
